name: Contact book
request:
a contact book: add a contact with a name, a phone number and an email
see every contact in one list, sorted by name
search the contacts by name
change or delete a contact

checks.given: The app is open and the contact book is empty.
steps: Add a contact named "Anna Berg" with the phone number 0401 234 567 and the email anna@example.com.
checks.expect: "Anna Berg" shows in the list of contacts, and opening her shows 0401 234 567 and anna@example.com.

steps: Fill in only the phone number 0401 234 567.
checks.expect: The contact is not saved, and the form says a name is needed.

features.name: Every contact in a list, sorted by name

checks.expect: Both show in the list, "Anna Berg" above "Zoe Quinn".

checks.given: The contact book holds "Anna Berg" and "Zoe Quinn".
checks.expect: "Anna Berg" shows and "Zoe Quinn" does not.

checks.given: The contact book holds "Anna Berg" and "Zoe Quinn".
checks.expect: No contact shows, and the page says no contact matches.

checks.given: The contact book holds "Anna Berg" with the phone number 0401 234 567.
checks.expect: Opening "Anna Berg" shows the phone number 0499 999 999.

checks.given: The contact book holds "Anna Berg" and "Zoe Quinn".
steps: Delete "Zoe Quinn", confirming if the app asks.
checks.expect: Only "Anna Berg" shows in the list.
